summary: Build Blueprint 10 (Admin Control Center & Content Ops) tested end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest passing (RBAC/me, dashboard cards incl recent_errors, users search+detail+suspend/restore/override/feature-override/delete guard, templates create+edit-safety-snapshot+publish+rollback+archive, safety auto-escalation from emergency chat, feature flags incl prod-disable guard, support user+admin flow, admin roles super-only + last-super 409 guard, immutable hash-chained audit + no mutation endpoints). Frontend: /admin sidebar shows 'Home Intelligence Ops', module mounts, role-bar 'Signed in as Super Admin', all tabs present (dashboard, users, templates, safety, support, flags, admins, audit), dashboard stat cards render (Total Users 141, Active Properties 18, Open Tickets 1, Recent safety event 'conversation_emergency_keyword emergency'), 8 feature flag toggles visible, user search returns demo_home. Fixed 1 real backend bug during testing (feature-override false 404).

minor.issue: Projection {_id:0, feature_override:1} returned {} for users without feature_override, causing 'if not u' to raise 404. FIXED by adding id:1 to projection.

action_items: Nothing blocking. The feature-override 404 bug was fixed in admin_ops_engine.py (added id:1 to projection); please review the one-line change on line 346.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops_engine.py is a single 658-line module — approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting user/template/safety/flag/support/admin submodules if it grows further.
Content tab in UI is labeled 'Content' but its testID is `ops-tab-templates` (matches the internal state key). Not a bug, just a naming inconsistency to be aware of for future UI tests.

Feature-override endpoint does NOT enforce confirm+reason like suspend/override/delete/publish do; consider whether temporary feature overrides should also require an audit reason (currently reason is optional).
Audit chain verified newest-first; prev_hash of newest equals entry_hash of next-newest. Chain integrity holds across 200 entries fetched.
updated_files: /app/backend/admin_ops_engine.py (fix: feature_override projection returns empty dict for users w/o feature_override → false 404)
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ prefixed data: 1 support ticket (resolved), 1 safety-type template (archived), 1 support_admin role briefly assigned to demo_home then removed. No production data mutated permanently (demo_home restored to active/free tier).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint returns {access_token, ...} not {token}. Conversation POST /api/hi/chat/conversations auto-creates a property (no property_id needed). Owner Diyhomieapp@gmail.com is auto-seeded as super_admin at startup ('admin ops (B10) seeded' log line). Non-admin users get 403 on all /api/hi/admin/* routes.
rca_of_issue: feature-override false 404 RCA: MongoDB find_one with projection {_id:0, feature_override:1} returns {} (empty dict) when a user doc exists but has no feature_override field. Python truthiness treats {} as falsy so `if not u:` raised 404 even for existing users. Fix: include `id:1` in projection so returned doc is always non-empty when user is found.
